orghs_symbol_entrez.source: Bioconductor package org.Hs.eg.db 3.22.0 (bioconda bioconductor-org.hs.eg.db 3.22.0): AnnotationDbi select, keytype SYMBOL, all keys; data from NCBI Gene
orghs_symbol_entrez.licence: Artistic-2.0 (package); NCBI Gene data are public domain
orghs_symbol_entrez.note: Gene symbol to Entrez gene map (193,613 rows; a symbol may map to several genes). Exported by PTM_Pipeline scripts/00_export_disease_tables.R; this repository checks the bytes. Citation: Carlson M, org.Hs.eg.db: Genome wide annotation for Human, R package 3.22.0.

disgenet_term_genes.source: Bioconductor package DOSE 4.4.0 (bioconda bioconductor-dose 4.4.0): its DisGeNET data DGN_PATHID2EXTID with DGN_PATHID2NAME
disgenet_term_genes.note: DisGeNET disease terms and their Entrez genes, one row per term and gene (30,170 terms, 1,134,942 rows). Exported by PTM_Pipeline scripts/00_export_disease_tables.R, which checks that DGN_EXTID2PATHID is the exact inverse of DGN_PATHID2EXTID; this repository checks the bytes. Citations: Yu G et al., Bioinformatics 31:608 (2015), doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btu684 (DOSE); Pinero J et al., Nucleic Acids Res 48:D845 (2020), doi:10.1093/nar/gkz1021 (DisGeNET).
